historical_context.time_period: Identity Abyss, early 2719, before the Pallas Species Strikes spread beyond one cavity yard
historical_context.location: An outward housing loop beside Cavity Twelve in a half-commissioned AU Bloom in the Pallas Bloom Cluster.
historical_context.summary: Residents whose employers classify them separately use one dented table, reusable door-and-clock clips, food, route overlap, and remembered obligations to cover care that AU does not record as work. A clinic and shift collision proves the arrangement works while exposing who must absorb its contractual cost.

public_facts.text: AU ramps control shifts, safety exceptions, maintenance budgets, resource access, and claims against future production; households depend on the ramp remaining recognized and supplied.
Pallas yards place baseline workers, BioElevate uplifts, VitaForge biodrones, supervisors, and contractors inside the same seal and air systems under different legal and liability categories.
BioElevate dry-yard cephalopod workers use mobile harnesses, humidity support, oxygenation loops, pressure cuffs, and interfaces optimized for productivity in human-built workspaces.
A biodrone may remember routes, coordinate work, protect others, improvise, or refuse, while suppliers and operators can classify the same action as product or conditioning failure.

ambient_pressures.text: A shared pressure door, shift scanner, clinic junction, galley, and yard tram make neighbors materially dependent even when their contract systems do not recognize one another's care.
Care consumes rest, food, service windows, claimshare margin, or exposure to supplier and labor audits; no informal handoff can alter AU's official absence record.
The same cross-category dependence that keeps one child supplied can later let a work stoppage travel across liability boundaries management expects to contain.

groups.label: Outward-loop households and shift neighbors
institutional_logic: Use existing routes and spare minutes to keep food, clinic pickups, child handovers, and work attendance from failing separately.
material_incentives: Preserve treatment windows, safe waiting, tailored food, harness service, housing standing, and the shifts that keep claimshares alive.
internal_virtues: Notice the route already being traveled
Complete the task without purchasing gratitude
Remember who is already carrying too much
internal_shames: Leaving an upright clip when one's route could have answered it
Turning care into a debt ledger
Making a differently classified neighbor own all the audit risk
prestige_markers: A clinic parcel delivered before its clock closes
A handover that lets both households keep their shifts
Food left where the next body can actually use it
taboo_triggers: Calling mutual help unauthorized labor after relying on its result
Treating a biodrone's judgment as a malfunction only when it benefits someone
emotional_display_norms: Affection travels through jars, clips, route changes, open doors, and jokes about administration; nobody needs to declare a movement.
trust_defaults: Trust is local, practical, and revised by completed handoffs; official classifications are poor evidence of who will show up.

groups.label: AU Ramp Administration and shift office
institutional_logic: Keep a developing habitat inside schedule, certification, safety, and claim rules while preserving AU's operating rights.
material_incentives: Maintain cavity throughput, assign absences to recognized workers, and prevent unofficial practices from creating unpriced liability.
internal_shames: A corridor practice outperforming official welfare
Cross-category coordination the scheduler cannot price
A successful outcome with no authorized owner
prestige_markers: An exception closed inside one record
emotional_display_norms: Confusion becomes a review channel; sympathy remains private and cannot close a record.
trust_defaults: Trusts badges, route orders, supplier diagnostics, and registered households more than a corridor's memory.

groups.label: BioElevate uplift and VitaForge biodrone workers
institutional_logic: Perform work through body support, route permissions, and supplier interfaces that can convert ordinary agency into diagnostic evidence.
material_incentives: Keep harnesses, tailored support, route access, bodily continuity, and neighbor recognition while surviving AU shifts.
internal_virtues: Refusal to confuse legal category with capacity
internal_shames: Allowing a supplier record to erase a completed act
Leaving another body to absorb a shared system's failure
prestige_markers: A route used safely outside its narrow assignment
A support clock protected without hiding who needed it
taboo_triggers: Product variance used as a synonym for judgment
Adaptation language used to normalize preventable discomfort
emotional_display_norms: Care is communicated through movement, touch, route ordering, equipment attention, and compressed speech.
trust_defaults: Trusts co-workers who understand body and route limits; distrusts offices that separate responsibility by supplier.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A route already being traveled is treated as care capacity before the helper's employer or legal category is considered.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Prompt actors to offer or refuse concrete route work and name its time or body cost, not to recite solidarity doctrine.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The ramp can tolerate informal kindness more easily than a repeatable coordination practice with no registered owner.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Administrative actors should translate a successful shared handoff into separate absence, obstruction, supplier, and household questions.

misread_patterns: Treats each helper as the source of one separate variance
Treats the shared result as nobody's authorized work
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let the clerk be materially correct about pressure-door clearance and still institutionally unable to recognize the care chain as one successful process.

observer_read: An office that arrives after the care worked
A scanner seeking one household to bill
target_self_read: Safety and schedule staff closing cross-system ambiguity
misread_patterns: Neighbors may underweight real pressure-door clearance duties
Administrators may privately understand the need but still preserve the record system
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the conflict about authority and cost rather than making every clerk personally cruel.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A seal rigger whose claimshare margin keeps one household housed while her clinic and shift obligations collide.
obligations: Avoid exporting all audit cost to neighbors
Preserve the care table if possible
failure_modes: Protecting the table by making it inaccessible

role_pressure_fields.summary: An uplifted cephalopod worker whose mobile harness makes human corridors usable at the cost of constant support and certification clocks.
obligations: Keep Pavi physically beside the harness
Refuse treatment as an interchangeable worker or mobility object

role_pressure_fields.summary: A six-limbed fixture-local biodrone whose route judgment and fine manipulators can complete a clinic pickup while exposing it to product-variance review.
obligations: Avoid letting a supplier diagnostic become the only account of the act
failure_modes: Human characters speaking over observable choice

role_pressure_fields.summary: A low-level administrator required to make one shared hallway legible to systems that own separate questions.
failure_modes: Privately understanding without changing what the office does

known_context.text: Lea knows her housing loop, Pavi's clinic clock, Cavity Twelve shift, claimshare margin, neighbor routes, and the table's practical use.

beliefs.text: Lea believes care is real work even when the ramp recognizes it only as private absence.

misreads.text: Lea may assume one more claimshare mark is survivable or that a supplier review will remain small.

must_not_know.text: Lea does not know how the later Pallas Species Strikes will spread or whether this corridor practice survives them.

known_context.text: Sori knows the local clinic and service routes, the harness clock, Pavi's safe grip position, and the body cost of dry operation.

beliefs.text: Sori treats the table as practical neighbor capacity, not official welfare or a declaration of political identity.

misreads.text: Sori may underestimate how quickly a missed support slot can become adaptation-variance evidence.

must_not_know.text: Sori cannot know the supplier or AU records opened outside the visible wall slates unless Imas states or shows them.

known_context.text: Imas knows the scanner field, shift exchange, supplier route alerts, housing record, and visible table contents.

beliefs.text: Imas believes each exception requires an owner because that is how the ramp can review and price it.

misreads.text: Imas may see the completed clinic route as proof of unauthorized coordination instead of proof that the official schedule omitted necessary care.

must_not_know.text: Imas cannot infer a formal labor movement or strike plan from one corridor table.

author_only_boundaries.text: Lea, Pavi, Sori, Kett-4, Imas, Cavity Twelve, and the exact handoff outcome are fixture-local draft material, not independently established historical persons or events.
The care table is a durable room-scale elaboration of AU ramp life. It is not a formal organization, strike cell, Aya project, or claim that this one household causes the Pallas Species Strikes.
Kett-4's six-limbed body and Sori's individual appearance and voice plate are fixture-local body details, not universal VitaForge or BioElevate designs.
